summary: The Lord’s vineyard (Israel) will become desolate, and His people will be scattered—Woes will come upon them in their apostate and scattered state—The Lord will lift an ensign and gather Israel—Compare 2 Nephi 15.
meta_description: The Lord’s vineyard (Israel) will become desolate, and His people will be scattered—Woes will come upon them in their apostate and scattered state—The Lord will lift an ensign and gather Israel—Compare 2 Nephi 15.

footnotes.note1_b: IE The prophet composes a song or poetic parable of a vineyard, showing God’s mercy and Israel’s unresponsiveness.
footnotes.note7_c: IE a riotous or raucous outcry.
footnotes.note8_c: IE be left to dwell alone. The wealthy landowners absorb the small farms of the poor.
footnotes.note18_c: IE they are tied to their sins like beasts to their burdens.
footnotes.note19_a: IE They will not believe in the Messiah until they see Him.
footnotes.note20_b: TG Discernment, Spiritual; God, the Standard of Righteousness.
footnotes.note23_c: IE deprive him of his legal rights.
footnotes.note26_a: TG Ensign; Millennium, Preparing a People for.
footnotes.note26_b: OR whistle; i.e., signal for the gathering. Isa. 7:18; 2 Ne. 29:2 (1–3).
